digest.component_or_area: metrics adapters — Claude Code transcript backfill
propositions: An optional, isolated backfill adapter must mine local Claude Code session transcripts to reconstruct environment and integration diagnostics without being imported by the core metrics command.

Error-signature grep patterns (LLMUnavailableError, ConnectionError, ModuleNotFoundError, etc.) must be extracted from transcript JSONL and deterministically classified into five categories (env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling, none) using keyword/regex matching, not LLM inference.
Emitted records must carry source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified labels to signal low-confidence backfill data and segregate it from authoritative structural metrics.

Unit tests must verify: (1) a fixture transcript with a known env-failure signature is extracted and classified deterministically; (2) core metrics modules do not import the adapter; (3) the backfill script entry point is exercised over fixture transcripts; (4) the classification enum and output schema are defined in the adapter module.
